plan.primary: 0.5 * mean(three Astra win rates) + 0.5 * mean(two bot2 win rates)

gates.specialist: versus D1: primary gain >= .01, paired seed-cluster 95% lower > 0, neither Astra nor bot2 declines > .05
gates.general: specialist gate plus old-pool versus H7 overall decline <= .03 and each opponent decline <= .10
gates.reliability: No unexplained errors, illegal actions, unexpected emergency fallback, or observed >2s local CLI decision; current-sequence legal output and exact artifact reproduction

plan.statistics: 10000 paired bootstrap replicates of whole shared seed clusters; report board, sticky, weakest matchup and both seats. No claims of formal noninferiority.
plan.errors: Every scheduled attempt remains charged. Harness errors count as zero score; do not drop anomalous pairs. An unexplained reliability error blocks promotion.
plan.selection: Start from unpromoted M1 with frozen D1/H7 controls. C1 exact/sampled public chance effects plus bounded adaptive continuation; C2 targeted search/guide or evaluation ablation chosen from development evidence. Use whole-game held-out counterfactual cases, no fitted weights in release. Re-evaluate parents on each fresh block, then independent retention. Freeze one candidate before final; no final-driven changes.
stop: At most three structural rounds plus one development retention block
Preserve 3200 full attempts for final/ZIP/client; reduce screening if necessary
plan.limits: Fixed D1 deck, fixed existing opponents, no models or external services during decisions. Public views only. Full terminal continuations count as full games.

selection: Independent retention: C2 328/384, C1 327/384, M1 325/384, D1 319/384. C2 vs M1 primary +1.04167 pp CI [-0.26042,+2.86458]; vs D1 +2.60417 pp CI [+0.52083,+4.6875]. Development-selected; final independent confirmation still required.
